** XML Input Decks

<<toc>>


= Overview

Overview of XML input deck, simple example like
{{{
#!xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!-- DASH -->
<Kaiju>
  <VOLTRON>
    <time tFin="18000.5"/>
    <spinup doSpin="T" tSpin="7200.0"/>
    <output dtOut="900.0" tsOut="100">
    <coupling dt="5.0" dtDeep="10.0" rTrc="40.0" imType="RCM" doQkSquish="T" doDynDT="F" qkSquishStride="2" doAsyncShallow="T"/>
    <restart dtRes="1800.0"/>
    <imag doInit="T"/>
    <ebsquish epsSquish="0.05"/>
    <threading NumTh="36"/>
    <helpers numHelpers="2" useHelpers="T" doSquishHelp="T"/>
  </VOLTRON>
  <Gamera>
    <sim runid="msphere" doH5g="T" H5Grid="lfmX.h5" icType="user" pdmb="1.0" rmeth="7UP"/>
    <floors dFloor="1.0e-4" pFloor="1.0e-6"/>
    <timestep doCPR="T" limCPR="0.25"/>
    <restart doRes="F" resID="msphere" nRes="-1"/>
    <physics doMHD="T" doBoris="T" Ca="10.0"/>
    <ring gid="lfm" doRing="T"/>
    <ringknobs doVClean="T"/>
    <wind tsfile="bcwind.h5"/>
    <source doSource="T" doWolfLim="T" doBounceDT="T" nBounce="1.0"/>
    <iPdir N="6" bcPeriodic="F"/>
    <jPdir N="4" bcPeriodic="F"/>
    <kPdir N="1" bcPeriodic="T"/>
    <threading NumTh="18"/>
  </Gamera>
  <CHIMP>
    <units uid="EARTHCODE"/>
    <fields grType="LFM"/>
    <domain dtype="MAGE"/>
    <tracer epsds="0.05"/>
  </CHIMP>
  <REMIX>
    <conductance doStarlight="T" doRamp="F" doMR="T"/>
    <precipitation aurora_model_type="RCMONO" alpha="0.2" beta="0.4" doAuroralSmooth="F"/>
  </REMIX>
  <RCM>
    <rcmdomain domType="ELLIPSE"/>
    <ellipse xSun="12.5" yDD="15.0" xTail="-20.0" isDynamic="T"/>
    <grid LowLat="30.0" HiLat="75.0" doLatStretch="F"/>
    <tomhd doAvg2MHD="T"/>
    <plasmasphere isDynamic="T" initKp="2" doRefill="T" DenPP0="1.0e-2" tAvg="600.0"/>
    <loss doRelax="F"/>
  </RCM>
</Kaiju>
}}}

= GAMERA

Example XML file

{{{
#!xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!-- Field loop advection 2D -->
<Kaiju>
  <Gamera>
      <sim runid="loop2d" icType="LOOP2D"/>
      <idir min="-1" max="1" N="256"/>
      <jdir min="-0.57735026" max="0.57735026" N="148"/>
      <kdir min="-0.5" max="0.5" N="1"/>
      <time tFin="2.0"/>
      <output dtOut="0.01" tsOut="100"/>
      <physics doMHD="T"/>
      <prob alpha="60"/>
  </Gamera>
</Kaiju>
}}}
